messages.content: Help me calculate the difference in days between the dates '2023-04-01' and '2023-04-15' using a specific time unit of 'days'?

function.name: sTe
function.description: This function calculates the difference between two dates in a specified time unit. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

r.description: The start date for the calculation. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

t.description: The unit of time to calculate the difference in. For example, 'days', 'hours', etc. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.
